If you mean “how do I call the API to use a model like you (ChatGPT)?” — that’s the OpenAI API. Brief summary and examples below; tell me which language or framework you want sample code for and I’ll provide it.

Quick overview
- Base: https://api.openai.com
- Authentication: Bearer API key (set via Authorization header).
- Two common patterns:
  - Chat Completions (older): /v1/chat/completions — send a sequence of messages with roles (system/user/assistant).
  - Responses API (newer, unified): /v1/responses — single endpoint that supports chat-style, tool calls, multimodal inputs, and richer outputs.

Minimal curl examples

1) Responses API (recommended for new integrations)
curl -s -X POST "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
    "input": "Translate the following English text to French: Hello, how are you?"
  }'

2) Chat Completions (legacy / widely used)
curl -s -X POST "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "messages": [
      {"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},
      {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the plot of Hamlet in one paragraph."}
    ]
  }'

Important notes
- Models: available model names change; check the docs for current models and capabilities (text, multimodal, streaming).
- Streaming: both APIs support streaming responses (server-sent events).
- Rate limits & pricing: dependent on your account and model; see your OpenAI dashboard and the docs.
- SDKs: official SDKs exist for JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and others; they wrap the HTTP calls.
- Docs & reference: https://platform.openai.com/docs — start there for full request/response schemas, examples, and best practices.

If you want a concrete code sample (Python, Node.js, Java, etc.), or help setting up keys/streaming, tell me which language and I’ll give a ready-to-run example.
